test_title: PYST 41: SSC CGL 2025 - General Knowledge (Held On: 25th_September_2025_Shift_2)
subject: general
question: Which government scheme aims to provide social security to workers in the unorganized sector?

options.text: Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act (MGNREGA)

solution:
The correct answer is __**Atal Pension Yojana**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__

• **Atal Pension Yojana (APY)** is a government-backed pension scheme in India aimed at providing **social security for workers in the unorganized sector.**

• Launched in **May 2015** by the Government of India, the scheme operates under the **Pension Fund Regulatory and Development Authority (PFRDA).**

• The scheme is open to all Indian citizens aged between **18 to 40 years**, with a focus on workers in the unorganized sector, such as laborers, drivers, domestic workers, and street vendors.

• Under APY, subscribers receive a **guaranteed monthly pension ranging from Rs. 1,000 to Rs. 5,000**, depending on their contribution and age at the time of joining.

• The contributions are made till the age of **60 years**, after which the pension benefits are disbursed.

• The scheme allows **spouses** to continue receiving the pension or claim the accumulated corpus in case of the subscriber's demise.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__

• **Eligibility for Atal Pension Yojana:**

• The subscriber must be an **Indian citizen** and have a **savings bank account** or a post office savings account.

• The entry age is restricted to **18-40 years**, ensuring a minimum contribution period of 20 years before receiving benefits.

• **Key Features:**

• The scheme guarantees a fixed monthly pension, with the government providing **co-contribution** for eligible subscribers who are not covered under any statutory social security scheme and are not income taxpayers.

• It is especially beneficial for workers in the **unorganized sector**, which constitutes around **85% of India's workforce**.

• **Funding and Management:**

• The scheme is managed by the **Pension Fund Regulatory and Development Authority (PFRDA)** under the **National Pension System (NPS).**

• The government's **co-contribution** is 50% of the subscriber's contribution or Rs. 1,000 per annum, whichever is lower, for a period of 5 years for eligible subscribers enrolled between June 1, 2015, and December 31, 2015.

• **Benefits to the Unorganized Sector:**

• The scheme provides a social safety net for individuals without formal pension coverage, especially those working in **low-income, informal jobs.**

• It ensures **financial stability** and promotes savings for old age among economically vulnerable sections of society.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

• **Other Government Schemes for Social Security:**

• **Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act (MGNREGA):** Provides guaranteed 100 days of wage employment in a financial year to rural households.

• **Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana (PMJDY):** Focuses on financial inclusion by providing access to banking services like savings accounts, credit, insurance, and pensions.

• **National Health Mission (NHM):** Aims at providing accessible, affordable, and quality healthcare services to rural and urban populations.

• **Global Perspective:**

• Similar schemes exist globally, such as **Social Security in the United States** and the **National Pension Scheme in South Korea**, which aim to provide financial stability and old-age security to workers.
